test_day_5_event.description: A mysterious merchant arrives at your establishment on this fifth day of your venture. 'I've been watching your progress,' he says with a knowing smile. 'You show promise. Let me offer you a choice of rewards to help your business grow.'

choices.option: Ask for gold to expand your business.
choices.message: The merchant smiles and hands you a pouch of gold coins. 'Invest wisely,' he says. 'Money well spent returns threefold.' (+300 gold)

choices.option: Ask for reputation to attract better clients.
choices.message: The merchant nods approvingly. 'Word of mouth is the best advertisement,' he says, spreading good word about your establishment throughout the district. (+15 reputation)

choices.option: Ask for information about the district.
choices.message: The merchant leans in conspiratorially. 'Knowledge is power,' he whispers, sharing valuable secrets about local politics and business opportunities. (Moderate gold and reputation bonus)
The merchant is impressed by your independence. 'Self-reliance is admirable,' he says. 'Here's a small token of respect.' (Small reputation bonus)

rich_traveler_day10.description: A wealthy traveler, cloaked in fine velvet and dust from the road, takes a seat at your table. 'I reward promising establishments,' he says. 'Choose your boon, and may fortune favor your choice.'

choices.option: Accept the traveler's heirloom sword (Iron Sword).
choices.message: You accept the heirloom blade with gratitude. Its balance is exquisite, its edge keen. (Iron Sword added to inventory)

choices.option: Take the sealed gift box. Whatever it holds is yours.
choices.message: You choose the mystery. The traveler grins, 'May luck be on your side.' (Random loot added)

choices.option: Invite Violet to join your roster (if she isn't already).
choices.message: You extend a formal invitation to Violet. 'I've been watching your progress,' she says. 'Very well, I'll lend you my talents.'

choices.option: Recruit a capable worker from passing caravans.
choices.message: You hold quick trials at dusk. A capable recruit impresses you and joins your ranks immediately.

choices.option: Decline politely. Your path is set without outside gifts.
choices.message: You refuse with a courteous bow. The traveler appreciates your conviction and leaves with a satisfied smile. (+5 Reputation)

new_event_2.description: Three mysterious figures land in your establishment, they say they have some gifts left from their journey, and offer you a boon.

choices.option: Ask for gold to expand your business.
choices.message: The kings offer you a bag with gold, smiling and after a bit, they leave to continue their journey.
